lower switch of leg B open (confidence 0.94)

BL_open match error 5.1% from simulate_hypotheses; Modulation step test: mu_B ratio after/before 1.018 vs expected 1.0 for switch fault; Datasheet shows I_C,nom = 50 A, used for derate limit. Check the gate drive of switch BL (S6): its STGAP2S driver and supply; if the gate signals are good, replace the A1P50S65M2 six-pack module (its switches cannot be replaced one by one)
Inspect and replace the lower IGBT switch in leg B

Verify torque and bonding of module
